name: Redragon M690 PRO
notes: 73-byte report descriptor of the mouse interface (interface 0) of a real Redragon M690 PRO, from the OpenMouse Project capture of the device: https://github.com/OpenMouse-Project/mouse-protocol/blob/80ba207332b02581d870697d74fa5d5b18d76033/captures/redragon-m690-pro/report-descriptors.hex#L5-L5. The source gives the device's name, not its own USB strings, so productString is that name. Other interfaces of the real device are not part of this profile.
